title: Floricum Ore
description: There is a new ore called Floricium. It's not so good as diamound, but ways better then iron!
body: This Mod adds the Floricium Ore, whith you can make to armor and tools. It adds some secret feachers too, like a secret effect oder trades. it was my first mod, so it isn't perfect. The armor ist better than diamound, but the tools not.
